content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Charlotte

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires only a secondary diploma (or equivalent) and completion of project management education hours—no prior work experience needed. This makes CAPM ideal for Charlotte professionals entering project management roles across finance, technology, healthcare, and other growing sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format fits working professionals' schedules while delivering the contact hours PMI requires. You'll learn core project management frameworks and processes from active certified practitioners.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing coursework, apply directly to PMI with your education documentation and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through the application process to ensure your credentials meet PMI's standards.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Take the proctored exam with exam-preparation support from Granite PM Academy. Our instructors equip you with study strategies, practice questions, and confidence to demonstrate your project management knowledge on test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: Renew your credential every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or professional activities. Staying current keeps your certification active and your skills aligned with industry standards.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
